runtimeTruth.existingEngine: buildPronunciationLesson: scripted listen-only beats, tip, ordered practice, at most one retry, then closing drill

assessmentModes.coach_only: Model and coach articulatory/rhythm behavior; completion is participation. Never infer sound quality from transcript.
assessmentModes.transcript_target_match: Check only whether STT text contains the intended word/phrase; one retry maximum. This verifies lexical attempt, not pronunciation quality.
assessmentModes.deterministic_choice: Learner taps what they heard/saw; score the selected option, not inferred audio production.
assessmentModes.orthographic_build: Learner orders visible sound/spelling tiles; score the constructed sequence deterministically.
assessmentModes.decode_transfer: Learner first builds/selects the decoding route, then reads aloud; decoding is scored, speech is participation/transcript match only.
assessmentModes.mixed_safe: Skill Check combines deterministic recognition/build tasks with coach-only or transcript-target speaking. Subscores stay separate.

nonNegotiables: Never claim that transcript-only input proves vowel length, voicing, stress, linking, mouth position or accent quality.
A recognition error may trigger one replay; a speaking mismatch may trigger one retry; neither creates an infinite loop.
Listen-only turns keep the mic hidden; every speaking turn ends with exactly one utterance target.
Wrong examples use existing TTS-safe Thai-script technique only when the contrast is reliably audible; never use Thai respelling for stress.
New phonics nodes teach a rule through examples, but every rule immediately transfers to useful A1 words or signs.
backendWorkNeededLater: Add node-kind metadata without breaking pron_* lesson IDs or current progress.
Add deterministic tile/choice payloads for sound_builder, listen_choose and decode nodes.
Keep existing lesson completion contract, banana cost and separate pronunciation catalog pointer.
Store recognition/build score separately from speech participation; reserve acoustic score for a future audio-capable provider.

shared.thresholdRule: Each node uses its explicit integer passThreshold; speaking never changes a deterministic score.
shared.wrongRule: After one retry, reveal the exact answer key and advance.

deliveryContract.stripRule: Before delivery, recursively remove every authoring* field, correctPattern and spoken transcript. Audio-only options expose no label/text/transcript. Image-only options expose no label/text and use opaque IDs.
deliveryContract.idRule: All client choice, audio, image and concept identifiers match opaque namespace plus digits only; identifiers must not contain target spelling.

oralMeaningPreExposureWithoutPrint.policy: Before an unseen meaning-picture item, play the concept audio and show its picture without any letters or target spelling. This establishes meaning while keeping orthography unseen.
